Does Brad Pitt die in 21 Jump Street?

He plays Peter, a supporting role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. He's the friend who yells at Penhall, not the kid who dies.

In this May 1988 episode, a troubled teen the Jump Street cops are investigating takes his own life, sending Penhall into a spiral. Pitt plays Peter, the boyfriend of a girl in the friend group, who confronts Penhall over his odd behavior. The death is another character; Peter walks away fine.

Some sources list the character as Jeff Deiner; IMDb credits him as Peter.
